study.question: Does the successful post-retrieval product adaptation depend on matching current-ad field identity to the retrieved history field, or can cross-field products supply complementary information at identical parameter count and controlled magnitude?
study.hypothesis: Observed limitation: the incumbent only forms aligned coordinate products q_category*hc + q_brand*hb, leaving cross-field value interactions untested. Round 7 product_target AUC=0.6162637997271082 exceeds additive_target by 0.0010960723099886 and product_context by 0.0009518156021355; the product/operator-by-source interaction is 0.0008707372104274. These are single-seed observations, not repeated proof. Mechanism hypothesis H_alignment: semantically aligned target/value products preserve useful field-specific relevance beyond generic multiplicative capacity; swapping only the operand pairing should lose more under target operands than history-mean operands. Competing H_complementarity: crossed products may better capture category-to-brand and brand-to-category relations. Earlier crossed value routing (0.6138332320 versus aligned 0.6153351064) and cross-query residuals (0.6150165528 versus self 0.6151220425) failed to improve, so no cross-field win is presumed. Those interventions act at other stages and cannot settle the new pairing contrast.

nearest_work.difference: Inherit candidate-aware local activation and explicit query/key relation features, adapted to separate category/brand reads. This local model uses normalized attention and a pooled-norm-controlled summary unlike DIN unnormalized interest intensity. Proposed change swaps post-retrieval multiplicative operands only, not attention or intensity.

nearest_work.difference: Retain the already adapted explicit second-order residual as context for an operand-pairing test. UniDot describes per-layer dots, Grams and a classifier highway; this experiment has one coordinatewise residual after field retrieval, no highway or dual buses. Neither this adaptation nor the pairing test has verified novelty.

QueryFormer generates/refines attention probes and scales embedding views; the current intervention preserves the queries and changes operands only after retrieval. Prior projection-only local failures are not a test of the full source method.
Reuse the complete model and change only product operand pairing. Aligned_target and aligned_context replay the matching existing cells; crossed cells are new. No new parameters or optimizer change.

inherited_components: All frozen host data, causal feature and scoring contracts; raw data remain host-owned and were not re-acquired in this proposal phase

Round-7 shared embeddings, DIN-style field attention, target retrieval queries, aligned base semantic/action/recency values, 16x16 zero-start projection, driver scaling, pooled norm control and classifier
Matched history-mean operand controls and unchanged training recipe
All prior successful, null and losing receipts remain evidence; no prior run in the trajectory index is marked failed, and previous_runtime_error is null
study.proposed_difference: For the new crossed variants only, replace raw=q_c*hc+q_b*hb with raw=q_b*hc+q_c*hb after unchanged independent field retrieval. Normalize either raw vector to ||concat(hc,hb)|| (zero if degenerate), apply the same trainable 16x16 map, add to the identical aligned base, and match the pooled reference norm. Cross this replacement with target versus masked-history-mean value operands, keeping retrieval target-aware in all four cells. There is no event shuffle, attention swap, extra branch, learned basis adapter, increased capacity or changed feature availability. This is a mechanism probe and a challenger, not a priority claim.
predictions: Predeclared primary contrasts: D_target=AUC(aligned_target)-AUC(crossed_target), D_context=AUC(aligned_context)-AUC(crossed_context), I=D_target-D_context. H_alignment predicts D_target>0 and I>0; report all four AUCs and unweighted Logloss without significance claims from this seed. H_complementarity instead predicts crossed_target>aligned_target; this reverses the interpretation, not the score direction.

Aligned_target should reproduce g2-r0007-product_target AUC 0.6162637997271082 and aligned_context should reproduce g2-r0007-product_context AUC 0.6153119841249727 under the matching frozen seed/config; any discrepancy requires execution/lineage review before attribution.

Candidate diagnostics should show identical attention/base decomposition, zero padding mass and empty-history summaries, small driver/summary norm errors, and nonzero pairing-switch driver/logit differences if the new path is active. These first-512, fixed-checkpoint diagnostics are descriptive candidate-supplied measurements, not causal performance estimates.

Use existing host bins for history length, hours, behavior composition, training frequency and category match, with supplied sample/positive/negative counts. Prior long-history product_target versus additive_target AUC gain was 0.0011177079 on n=3026583 (151372 positives, 2875211 negatives), but history_17_64 lost 0.0008565341 on n=157391 (6311 positives, 151080 negatives). These are exploratory observations; do not predict a uniform slice gain or average slice AUCs. Missing-brand diagnostic groups report counts and perturbations only, not new label-based slice performance.
falsifiers: D_target<=0 weakens field-alignment dependence; I<=0 weakens target-specific alignment dependence. If crossed wins, preserve that counterevidence and revise the explanation. One sign difference remains provisional until paired repetition.

No material pairing-switch driver/logit change despite nonzero learned projection makes a null outcome uninformative about the intended mechanism; inspect implementation or degeneracy before further training.

Failure of aligned seed-42 replays, mismatched source/config/coverage, nonfinite diagnostics, substantial norm/padding/empty-history errors invalidates intended attribution and triggers a cost-charged investigation.

No challenger improvement over the incumbent is a valid negative performance result, even if alignment attribution receives support. The experiment cannot establish novelty, refute general cross-field dependence, or validate full UniDot/QueryFormer.

Same parameter count and data passes do not guarantee equal actual runtime; compare host-measured training, inference, memory and latency before any efficiency claim

knowledge_assessments.rationale: Primary exact-version text inspected at lines 163-207 and 490-513. Round-7 declared use was executed with matched product/additive and target/context replacements; observed positive factorial interaction 0.0008707372 is preliminary local support for that compact adaptation, not a source-method or knowledge-value causal result. This round examines an unresolved operand-pairing limitation.
knowledge_assessments.transformed_mechanism: Keep inherited compact explicit product residual and replace its operand pairing at equal parameter count and controlled norms; no new highway, dual buses or loss.
knowledge_assessments.nearest_work_difference: Coordinatewise post-retrieval value residual with a shared 16x16 map and matched norms, rather than per-layer scalar dot/Gram classifier bypasses. Novelty remains unverified.
knowledge_assessments.falsifier: Nonpositive D_target or factorial I weakens alignment-specific interpretation. No test of full UniDot and no transfer claim for its reported leaderboard result.
